rarity

three ways a pull gets rare.

every card rolls three times: what it is, how it's graded, and whether it comes out shiny. stack all three and the value goes through the roof.

shiny

a different color than it should be

normal Gengar₽120
shiny Gengar₽480
bonus+₽360

1 in 20 cards comes out shiny: alternate colors, rainbow foil and sparkles across the whole card. a shiny is worth four times its normal version.

grade

a perfect gem mint 10

graded 9 · mint₽200
graded 10 · gem mint₽340
bonus+₽140

every pull is slabbed and graded from 7 to 10 the moment it leaves the pack. a 10 is worth 1.7× the base price, a 7 only about half.

tier

a legendary or mythic hit

chance per card · route 1 pack1.0%
chance per card · mythic pack12.0%
mythic valueup to ₽6,500

six rarity tiers, from common Pidgeys to mythic Mews. when a rare card is about to show up, its back starts glowing before you flip it. gold means legendary. rainbow means mythic.

packs

every pack, priced.

three foil packs, five cards each, and the last card is always rare or better. each pack shows its odds, its expected value, and its floor (what you'd get if you sold every card back at the 60% buyback).

guide

how a pull works.

01

pick a pack

route 1, elite or mythic. better packs cost more ₽ but tilt the odds toward big hits.

⌄
02

rip it open

tap the pack to shake it and tear the top off. the color of the light that spills out hints at your best card.

⌄
03

flip your five

five cards fly out face down. glowing backs mean something rare is hiding. flip them one by one, or reveal all.

⌄
04

graded and priced

each card gets a grade from 7 to 10 and a price based on its tier, its grade and whether it's shiny.

⌄
05

keep it or sell it back

everything goes to your vault. fill your dex, or sell cards back at 60% to fund the next rip.

let it rip.

every pack is five chances. every flip could be the one. every card goes in your vault.
